notes: The playlist header runtime no longer dies behind an ellipsis on narrow screens: tap the "238 tracks · 12h ..." line and a bubble pops up above it with the exact total length, down to the second.
Album cards work the same way — tap the runtime under an album name for its exact total time, without expanding or collapsing the album.
The popup looks and behaves like the media player song-name bubble: floats above the line you tapped, second tap or scrolling closes it, and it auto-hides after four seconds.
